purpose: Execute adoption/sdk/README.md's uv-based hash-locked SDK reproduction (the recipe's equivalent of `uv sync --locked` for this repository, since the 36-distribution SDK graph is published as a hash-locked requirements.txt-style lock, not a uv-project uv.lock) in a brand-new venv with UV_CACHE_DIR pointed at a fresh, empty, per-run temp directory, narrowing open_gaps[recovery-portability][10] (previously only source-reviewed, or executed with a reused host package cache).
preregistered: If `uv venv` (fresh prefix) followed by `uv pip sync --require-hashes --no-build --strict --no-sources adoption/sdk/requirements-linux-x86_64-py313.lock` against a brand-new empty UV_CACHE_DIR (created fresh per run with mktemp -d, never reused across runs) both exit 0 and resolve/install exactly the documented 36 distributions, and a second independent run with its own fresh venv and fresh empty cache reproduces the same exit codes and count, that settles open_gaps[10]'s 'not executed with an empty cache' item. A nonzero exit code, a hash mismatch, or a distribution count different from 36 on either run would refute the assumption that this SDK graph resolves cleanly with an empty cache and must be recorded as a failure.

result: Two fully independent runs (separate venvs, separate freshly-created empty UV_CACHE_DIR per run via mktemp -d, never reused) of the adoption/sdk hash-locked sync each exited 0 for venv creation, `uv pip sync --require-hashes`, and `uv pip check`, and each resolved and installed exactly the documented 36 distributions with no source builds (six wheels were genuine cache misses requiring download: pandas, openai, duckdb, numpy, pydantic-core, openai-codex-cli-bin; the rest were resolved from PyPI's index metadata plus hash verification). `uv pip list` confirms 36 named distributions matching accepted-constraints.txt's count.

verdict_impact.explanation: Directly executes (rather than only source-reviews) the hash-locked SDK reproduction with a genuinely empty, freshly created cache directory per run, on two independent runs, both succeeding with the documented distribution count. This supports uv's incumbent status for hash-locked reproducibility. It remains on the same existing WSL host (not a second physical machine, which open_gaps[0], [7] and [9] separately require), so it narrows but does not close open_gaps[10].

limitations: Same existing WSL host as all prior uv clean-prefix evidence; not a second physical or virtual machine.
PyPI network access was available and used for both runs (six packages were genuine downloads); this is not an offline/air-gapped reproduction test.

`uv pip sync` against a hash-locked requirements.txt-style lock (the actual published artifact in this repository) rather than `uv sync --locked` against a uv-project pyproject.toml/uv.lock, since no such project exists at this path; per adoption/sdk/README.md this is the repository's own documented equivalent for this SDK graph.

The scratch venvs (<scratch>/sdk-env-w2 and its exit-check rerun sibling) are left on disk as durable evidence under the session state directory, not committed to the repository (517MB, well over the 1MB inline threshold).
